name: Serious to the End
source:
Our narrator, born in Hawaii, meets a young college student who goes to the same school. He was practicing for the 10k marathon until he saw the girl crying. Her name is Aya and her troubled life is making her consider suicide or murder as an alternative to being happy. As the story progresses, more and more life-changing events that happen almost everyday in the real world unfold.

[Edited from [url=https://firecat.itch.io/serious-to-the-end]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
出生于夏威夷的叙述者遇到同校的一名年轻女大学生。他原本正在为一万米马拉松训练，直到看见女孩哭泣。她叫绫，困扰不堪的生活让她开始考虑以自杀或谋杀代替幸福。

随着故事推进，现实世界中几乎每天发生的、足以改变人生的事件将接连展开。

[改编自[url=https://firecat.itch.io/serious-to-the-end]Itch.io[/url]]
